title: PrimaLuce token lookup assumes an unused array sentinel
summary: - Location: indigo_drivers/shared/primalucelib/primalucelib.c:374-405, specifically 394-399; parser acceptance at 253-265; capacity in primalucelib.h:77-78,502-503. - Severity: medium; confidence: high from source; category: security/input validation. Owner: coordinator; status: open; nonblocking audit follow-up. - Evidence: parser accepts every positive jsmn return, including all 1024 allocated tokens; it does not retain the returned token count. The missing-key/subtree skip increments index and reads tokens[index] until an undefined sentinel or sibling is found, with no capacity/count bound. A completely occupied valid token array has no undefined sentinel after its last token. Searching for an absent field after a final nested subtree can therefore advance beyond tokens[1023]. The 8192-byte response buffer allows a token-dense JSON response to fill the token array. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-2). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
